name: PM Vishwakarma
summary: A scheme that supports traditional artisans and craftspeople with skill training, modern toolkits, collateral-free credit and market linkages to improve the quality and reach of their products and services.

eligibility_clauses.text: The applicant must be 18 years of age or older.

entitlement_rules.text: An eligible artisan receives a toolkit incentive of Rs. 15000 along with skill training.

appeal_hierarchy.description: First grievance at the local office.

appeal_hierarchy.authority: Ministry of Micro, Small and Medium Enterprises
